leads.title: U.S. Department of State 2010 Human Rights Report - Gabon
leads.documents: Discrimination and violence against lesbian, gay, bisexual, and transgender (LGBT) persons as a problem in Gabon; LGBT individuals keeping status secret for fear of harassment/discrimination.
leads.detail: Cited in text as: U.S. Department of State's 2010 Human Rights Report. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: UN Declaration on Sexual Orientation and Gender Identity (December 2008)
leads.documents: Gabon co-sponsored and signed non-binding UN declaration calling for global decriminalization of homosexuality; one of only six African countries to do so.
leads.detail: Cited in text as December 2008 declaration. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: Joint Statement on Ending Acts of Violence and Related Human Rights Violations Based on Sexual Orientation and Gender Identity at the United Nations (2011)
leads.documents: UN statement condemning violence and discrimination against LGBTQ people; Gabon voted against it.
leads.detail: Cited in text as 2011 joint statement at the United Nations. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: Gabon Penal Code revisions enacted 5 July 2019
leads.documents: Criminalisation of homosexual relations between consenting adults with penalty up to 6 months imprisonment and/or fine up to 5 million CFA francs; period of criminalization July 2019 to June 2020.
leads.detail: Cited in text as revisions enacted 5 July 2019. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: Interfaith Diversity Network of West Africa - statement by Davis Mac-Iyalla
leads.documents: Documented enforcement incident under 2019 law: claim of two men arrested in Gabon who had to bribe police to be let go.
leads.detail: Attributed in text to Davis Mac-Iyalla of the Interfaith Diversity Network of West Africa. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: Gabon government bill to decriminalise same-sex sexual activity (2020)
leads.documents: Decriminalization process: National Assembly approval 23 June 2020, Senate approval 29 June, signed by President Ali Bongo 7 July 2020; age of sexual majority set at 15 for girls and 18 for boys.
leads.detail: Cited with dates: National Assembly 23 June 2020, Senate 29 June, signed 7 July 2020. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: Constitution of Gabon adopted by national referendum November 2024
leads.documents: Legal status of same-sex relationships: provision explicitly defining marriage as union between a man and a woman as unamendable eternity clause; took effect 12 April 2025.
leads.detail: Cited as November 2024 constitution via referendum with clause: Le mariage, union entre deux personnes de sexe opposé. Effective 12 April 2025. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: Law No. 025/2023 of 09/07/2023 amending Law No. 001/2011 of 25 September 2011 on the Protection of Personal Data
leads.documents: Rights machinery: included sexual orientation and sexual life as sensitive data; limited protections based on sexual orientation, no protection for gender identity.
leads.detail: Cited by law number and dates: Law No. 025/2023 of 09/07/2023 amending Law No. 001/2011 of 25 September 2011. No URL visible in provided text.
